name: Transcribe Audio
description: Transcribe or analyze an audio file using an audio-capable LLM.

function.name: transcribe_audio
function.description: Listen to an audio file (e.g. a voice message attachment) using an audio-capable LLM. Returns a verbatim transcript by default, or answers a specific question about the audio. Use this to understand audio content without needing to feed the audio directly to the main LLM. Requires the agent to have audio_enabled=1.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the audio file (.ogg, .oga, .opus, .mp3, .wav, .m4a, .aac, .flac, .webm).

query.description: Optional specific question about the audio (e.g. 'What language is spoken?'). Write your question in English. If omitted, returns a verbatim transcript.

mock_response: {"transcript":"This is a sample transcript from the mock response. In production, this would be the actual transcription of the audio content."}
